tools.name: addevent_list_calendars
tools.description: List the account's calendars (newest first by default) with id, title, timezone, whether it is the default calendar, landing-page links and counts of events and subscribers. GET /calendars.

tools.name: addevent_get_calendar
tools.description: One calendar by id: title, timezone, week start, template ids, subscriber and event counts, links, custom data. GET /calendars/{id}.

tools.name: addevent_create_calendar
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new calendar in the AddEvent account (a new, empty calendar; nothing existing is changed and nobody is notified). Needs a title. POST /calendars.

tools.name: addevent_update_calendar
tools.description: WRITE: changes fields of an existing calendar (only the fields you pass; the rest stay). Title, description and timezone changes show on its landing page and can reach people who subscribe to the calendar feed. Not reversible by this server (no previous values are kept), so read the calendar first.

tools.name: addevent_list_events
tools.description: Search the account's events (newest created first; by start time when a date filter is used): title, start/end, timezone, location, RSVP settings and stats, landing-page links. Filter by calendar, event ids, text, date window or a custom_data pair. GET /events.

tools.name: addevent_get_event
tools.description: One event by id (evt-...): all fields incl. description, organizer, reminder, recurring rule, RSVP settings and stats, custom data and share links. GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: addevent_create_event
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new event on a calendar (the account's default calendar if calendar_id is omitted). Creates a public event landing page and share links; it does not e-mail anyone, though people subscribed to that calendar's feed will see the event on their next sync. Needs title and datetime_start.

tools.name: addevent_update_event
tools.description: WRITE: changes fields of an existing event (only the fields you pass; the rest stay). tools.name: addevent_list_rsvp_attendees
tools.description: List RSVP attendees (personal data: e-mail addresses and the answers they gave on the RSVP form). Filter by calendar, event or response (going/maybe/not-going). Paged, 20 at most per page: read only what the task needs. IP address and coordinates are removed from the reply. GET /rsvps.

tools.name: addevent_get_rsvp_attendee
tools.description: One RSVP attendee by id (personal data: e-mail and form answers; IP address and coordinates removed). GET /rsvps/{id}.

tools.name: addevent_create_rsvp_attendee
tools.description: WRITE: adds ONE RSVP attendee (one e-mail address, personal data) to an event. tools.name: addevent_update_rsvp_attendee
tools.description: WRITE: changes ONE RSVP attendee (email, response or form answers; only the fields you pass). The event's reminder and update e-mails go to the e-mail address stored here, so changing it redirects those e-mails to that person. This server never triggers the confirmation or organizer notification e-m

tools.name: addevent_list_calendar_subscribers
tools.description: List people subscribed to the account's calendars (personal data: the form answers they gave, such as name and e-mail; calendar app type, sync status). Paged, 20 at most per page. IP address and coordinates are removed. GET /subscribers.

tools.name: addevent_get_calendar_subscriber
tools.description: One calendar subscriber by id (personal data; IP address and coordinates removed). GET /subscribers/{id}.

tools.name: addevent_list_rsvp_forms
tools.description: The account's RSVP forms (id, name), newest first. Use the id as rsvp_form_id on an event. GET /events/rsvp-forms.

tools.name: addevent_list_event_templates
tools.description: The account's event landing page templates (id, name), newest first. Use the id as landing_page_template_id on an event. GET /events/templates.

tools.name: addevent_list_calendar_templates
tools.description: The account's calendar landing page templates or embeddable calendar templates (id, name), newest first. Use the id as landing_page_template_id / embeddable_calendar_template_id on a calendar. GET /calendars/templates.

tools.name: addevent_list_timezones
tools.description: Timezone names AddEvent supports (use them as the timezone of events and calendars), with current UTC offset. Optional text filter on the name. GET /timezones.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: addevent_update_calendar · Public sink: addevent_create_calendar, addevent_get_event, addevent_create_event, addevent_update_event, addevent_create_rsvp_attendee, addevent_update_rsvp_attendee.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: addevent_update_calendar · Public sink: addevent_create_calendar, addevent_get_event, addevent_create_event, addevent_update_event, addevent_create_rsvp_attendee, addevent_update_rsvp_attendee

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
